reviews.text:
Good afternoon,

You know perfectly well which animal and case I'm referring to. His name is Boby. I've attached the invoice you charged me so you can recall.

Instead of acknowledging what happened and apologizing, you seem to prefer pretending you don't know what animal it is.
All you cared about was getting paid for the consultation. Luckily, another veterinarian was able to treat Boby, and now he's fine. You didn't even know how to treat the pain in his paw or prescribe an anti-inflammatory.

What happened seems worrying, regrettable, and shameful to me.

The response you gave me from the Yurbata Veterinary Center only makes me more distrustful. It demonstrates a lack of honesty and transparency.

The veterinarian at Yurbata did nothing more than examine the animal and express his anal glands. The reason for the consultation was to take an X-ray and obtain a correct diagnosis. Because the animal hurt his paw, if she didn't know how to perform the X-ray or couldn't do it correctly, the least she could have done was tell me by phone so I could take Boby to another veterinarian without wasting time.
What happened seems regrettable and shameful to me.

My experience at the Yubarta Veterinary Center was very negative.

I called the veterinarian and explained that my dog ​​Boby had hurt his paw and that, if he needed an X-ray, I wanted to know if she could do it. She said yes.

When I arrived, she examined the dog and told me she could take the X-ray, but that she wasn't sure she could make a correct diagnosis. She charged me €59 for the consultation. My dog ​​Boby was in pain in his paw, and in the end, she didn't take the X-ray or give me any diagnosis.

Then she told me she would send me to the same clinic, where they could take the X-ray and make the diagnosis, and that she would send me the information via WhatsApp. She never sent it. I had to call her, and after telling me she was busy, she finally gave me an address.
When I called that clinic, they informed me that I would have to pay for another consultation in addition to the X-ray. I asked if it was the same clinic, and they clearly told me no, it was a different one.
What I find appalling is the lack of information, transparency, and professionalism. If she had explained from the beginning that she was referring me to another clinic and that I would have to pay for another consultation, I could have decided how to proceed.
When it comes to an animal's health, trust and transparency are fundamental. After what happened, frankly, it makes me very distrustful.
Excellent service and fair price
Our go-to vet for the last 6 years and we wouldn't change them for anything.

My old vet closed, and I found Yubarta on Instagram. My cat is a bit particular, but as soon as he saw they weren't rushing him and were taking things slowly, he was wonderful. I left delighted; everything was done at a relaxed pace, and they patiently answered all my questions!

Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic in Madrid. Our furry friend is always happy to go there because of the love and care they show each patient.
Thank you for the great work.

Just arrived from Argentina and the attention I'm receiving from Amaya is EXTRAORDINARY!!!
Warmth, professionalism, and absolute dedication. THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU!!! And kisses from Donnita too.
100% RECOMMENDATION
A wonderful experience from the start! I've been bringing my cat for 5 years and will continue to do so. Thank you so much for everything!

We've been going to this clinic for almost eight years, ever since we adopted Kokoro, and we couldn't be happier. So much so that, even after moving and living far away, we still go back.
From the beginning, they've been incredibly patient and gentle with her, given how fearful she is due to her past life, and they've adapted to her pace.
Whenever we've had a problem, they've responded quickly, and the service has always been impeccable.
It's wonderful to have a clinic you can trust, especially when you have a dog who's so fearful.
Thank you for everything!

Excellent place! I visited it on the recommendation of the Madrid City Council. It was a shame and a pain to say goodbye to our hamster, but my little ones have developed asthma and the doctor forbade it. Triton is in excellent hands.
I went on time because I don't live there and the service was excellent, much appreciated because it's not always like that when they know you're just passing through.
Highly professional and excellent service. Lovely staff.
Thank you so much for your review!
The service is wonderful. My vet recently closed, and I'm so lucky to have found them.

I brought my dog to the clinic today because she is limping with age. And the contact with the vet was beyond my expectations. She speaks very good english, and took the time for a big check-up and to explain everything. She was very friendly and kind.
I had a consultation and they contacted me every day for a week until they confirmed my dog ​​was recovered. They didn't charge extra and patiently answered all my questions. That says it all 🙏🏻 …

My vet recently closed, I found you through Google and I'm so glad because what a difference! The vet was very calm with my dog, who is very scared. She explained everything to me and gave me very useful ideas for several problems I was having with him. Thank you, it's so nice to leave the clinic understanding everything and knowing I can ask you if I have any questions! ;)
They are lovely, very attentive to everything both during the consultation and in the days that follow.

I've been taking my kitten Oro to the clinic since February and I couldn't be happier. Oro has asthma and they treat him with so much care. They explain the condition in detail and always answer my questions. I definitely recommend them. Thank you!!! 🐱🐶🌈🙏🏻 …
Humane and professional. Due to moving, I've had several good vets, but never ones this good. Highly recommended, don't change.

First of all, if this vet has 4.7 stars, it's because the employees themselves beg their clients to rate them before leaving that sort of cave.

A year later, I feel qualified to write and review the reality of that place, and that is that, without a doubt, they only take risks with vaccinations or nail trimming; they leave everything else to others (in whom we have to blindly trust). I lost my dog ​​a little over a year ago. I don't blame them for her illness, but I do blame them for the terrible experience and complete lack of care we received from Lucía and Amaya in her final days. They were only focused on making money and providing misleading and inconsequential results. When we finally ended up at a veterinary hospital, they told us that the ultrasounds and tests they had done on my dog ​​were completely useless because the areas analyzed/photographed weren't reflected.

To this we must add the lack of urgency with which they treated her when it came to providing results or solutions (more than 5 days for a general analysis) while my dog ​​was dying at home.
As always, and knowing them (since it's a neighborhood vet with a pretty bad reputation), I expect a response that judges me personally and not the poor procedure and complete lack of professionalism of the clinic and its employees.
Hopefully, this will at least serve to save some of you from the temptation of taking your furry friend there.
